summary: Public Expo preview loaded at 390x844 without runtime crash or horizontal overflow. Backend regression passed 2/2; authenticated dashboard, seven-day plan, manual activity, weight logging, and coach response were exercised after completing onboarding. Fresh login incorrectly reopened onboarding instead of the completed account dashboard.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful login, the returned completed profile is discarded and Root keeps profile=null, so every fresh login enters onboarding. Reproduced with preview.user.2026@example.com despite GET /api/me returning onboarding_complete=true and a profile.
Settings Pressable has accessibilityLabel but no accessibilityRole or testID, so it cannot be reliably located as a button in accessibility automation.

action_items: Set profile from the login response when it is present, or fetch /me after AuthScreen onAuth before deciding whether onboarding is needed.
Add accessibilityRole="button" and stable testID to the settings header control, plus stable testIDs for coach send and remaining critical actions.
Retest fresh login, settings privacy toggles/language, and sign out after the session handoff fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Root's onAuth callback sets token and user but never profile; this is the root cause of the completed-account onboarding regression.
The app is concentrated in index.tsx with a very large stylesheet; maintainability risk remains, but it did not block this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 80%: preview load, dashboard after onboarding, plan, move, progress and coach passed; fresh-login session routing and settings automation failed

seed_data_creation: No new seed account. Existing preview account received one test activity and one test weight during UI validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use documented preview credentials. Fresh login currently enters onboarding because profile is not hydrated from login response. API GET /me confirms the account profile exists. Coach API returned HTTP 200 with source=groq in this run. Settings control lacks button role/testID.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open a fresh browser session, sign in with preview.user.2026@example.com / StrongPass123, observe onboarding instead of dashboard. AuthScreen calls onAuth(token, user); Root's callback only calls setToken and setUser, while profile remains null. Root therefore renders OnboardingScreen even though the backend login user is onboarding_complete=true and /api/me contains profile data. Mitigation: hydrate profile from login result or call /me immediately after login before rendering.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md; credentials were present and valid.
